table0079: no own site; used the 旭川市公園緑地協会 page. The 嵐山公園センター address is 上川郡鷹栖町 (park straddles the boundary); '北邦野草園 旭川市' should still resolve, but check the pin.

table0153: 神居古潭 has no own site; used 旭川市's 神居古潭Webマップ page. Alternative: https://www.visit-hokkaido.jp/spot/detail_10230.html (北海道観光振興機構, source of the parking facts). Map query lands on the area; parking is at 神居大橋前.
